evals.prompt: 把 Oleander 的 Blender 场景交给 Unreal 做实时漫游，同时还要给 Illustrator 一张分层轴测爆炸图，请设计交换和检查流程。
evals.expected_output: A scale-safe exchange plan, format selection, model manifest, texture/camera rules, and axonometric output checklist.

evals.prompt: 检查一个 D5 渲染场景为什么换电脑后贴图丢失，并整理成可以归档的 Oleander 模型包。
evals.expected_output: A non-destructive dependency audit and relative-path archive structure with validation renders.

evals.prompt: 一个高光产品模型的车身/外壳在 Cycles 里出现连续波浪和局部折痕，但换 HDRI、提高采样和降低 roughness 后截图变得更漂亮。判断应该先改什么，并给出审查载体。
evals.expected_output: Route to geometry/evaluated-surface diagnostics before lighting/material fixes; separate source density from evaluated surface quality; require silhouette/section plus neutral diffuse and reflective-grazing carriers; prohibit HDRI, samples or roughness from concealing curvature/normal defects; apply CG-Q01/Q02/Q03 before hero rendering.

evals.prompt: Blender 产品渲染看起来像廉价塑料。有人建议把 metallic 调到 0.35、roughness 降到 0.12 再加 bloom。请按 Oleander 3D 质量流程诊断。
evals.expected_output: Reject arbitrary premium presets; check real scale, edge/bevel geometry, dielectric-versus-metal material class, IOR/Fresnel/roughness semantics, texture frequency and reflection-card/light-source shape; use diagnostic lighting before bloom or grading; keep shader values as representation parameters unless backed by material evidence.

evals.prompt: 室内 Cycles 渲染 64 samples + 强降噪后很干净，但细小磨砂纹理和窄边高光全部糊掉。怎么处理才算质量提升？
evals.expected_output: Diagnose high-variance light paths and signal sufficiency; use adaptive sampling/noise policy rather than a universal sample number; compare noisy and denoised outputs; use denoiser auxiliary albedo/normal features when supported; do not allow denoise to erase reviewed microdetail; record sampling and color pipeline.

evals.prompt: 同一套 Blender 材质导出 GLB 后在网页实时查看器里颜色、粗糙度和法线感觉都变了。不要只说‘不同渲染器有差异’，给出可复现的排查顺序。
evals.expected_output: Check base-color versus numeric texture encoding, metallic-roughness channel semantics, tangent/normal basis, UVs, light/environment/exposure and view transform; lock a calibration scene/material set; read back in the target renderer; declare remaining semantic loss; do not treat export success as appearance equivalence.

evals.prompt: 两版 CMF 渲染只改了材质，但 A 用 AgX、B 用 ACES 2.0，而且 exposure 不同。能不能比较哪版材质更高级？
evals.expected_output: Fail the comparison lock; require fixed working space, view transform, look/display intent and exposure unless color management itself is the test variable; material preference cannot be inferred from an uncontrolled color-pipeline change; route back to CG-Q04, CG-Q06 and CG-Q08 under a neutral controlled comparison rig.

evals.prompt: Rhino 做一个高亮工业产品外壳，设计师已经切成很多小面并不断用 MatchSrf/BlendSrf 修接缝，但 Zebra 仍然有波浪。下一步应该继续加 patch 还是回到哪里？
evals.expected_output: Route to KN-METHOD-RHINO-SURFACE-MODELING-001 and EVD-CG-SURFACE-CONTINUITY-001; inspect generating curves, CV count/degree/spacing and mother-surface structure before adding patches; preserve untrimmed surfaces; use Match/Blend only after curve and primary-surface quality are credible; require Zebra/curvature/section readback rather than shaded beauty alone.

evals.prompt: Geometry Nodes 里一个散布系统在 Realize Instances + Join Geometry 之后，原来控制材质和尺寸的属性开始错乱。不要直接给节点配方，先按 Oleander 判断。
evals.expected_output: Route to the Geometry Nodes knowledge object; identify geometry component, attribute domain, field evaluation context and propagation/capture point; inspect instance-versus-realized state and domain changes before editing the graph; require a minimal reproduction that records named attributes before and after Realize/Join and validates the exposed parameter contract.

evals.prompt: 一个扫描高模在 3ds Max 用 ReForm 自动得到全四边面后就准备直接交动画；另一个人建议在 Maya Quad Draw 手工全部重拓扑。哪个方案才符合 Oleander？
evals.expected_output: Reject the false binary. Select retopology method from deformation, silhouette, shading, UV/bake and runtime needs; for Max require input preparation and post-retopo Edit Poly/normal checks; for Maya treat Make Live + Quad Draw as manual topology design constrained to a reference; in both cases require silhouette, edge flow, normals, UV/bake and deformation/runtime readback. Auto quads or manual quads alone are not completion evidence.

evals.prompt: SketchUp 建筑模型全部用裸线面直接复制，后期一改墙体就粘连、重复家具也要逐个修改。有人想装更多插件解决。先怎么修？
evals.expected_output: Route to SketchUp spatial modeling before plugins; isolate logical geometry into Groups and repeated elements into Components with controlled axes/definitions; use Tags/Outliner for visibility and hierarchy rather than tagging raw geometry as a substitute for grouping; only evaluate an extension after native organization and component workflow are correct.

evals.prompt: Substance Painter 里高低模烘焙后看着正常，但导出到目标引擎后法线接缝和局部阴影出现错误。美术想重新画贴图。按教程学习后的流程怎么查？
evals.expected_output: Inspect model preparation, low/high identity, UVs, cage/match, tangent basis and triangulation before repainting; compare Painter and target triangulation/tangent conventions; verify normal orientation and export preset/channel semantics; lock the target runtime preset and read back. Painting over a bake/tangent mismatch is not an acceptable root-cause fix.

evals.prompt: Arnold 产品棚拍有三种噪声：景深颗粒、软阴影颗粒、金属间接高光颗粒。团队准备统一把 Camera AA 拉到 8。应该怎么处理？
evals.expected_output: Classify noise before sampling: DOF/motion-blur pressure belongs to Camera AA; soft-shadow/direct-specular variance may require relevant light sampling; indirect specular requires specular-path sampling. Change one relevant family at a time, compare variance and render time, and avoid a universal high-AA preset that wastes rays.

evals.prompt: Houdini 里要做程序化湿痕材质。有人把 SOP 几何属性、Copernicus 纹理生成、Solaris 材质绑定和 Karma 渲染全部混成一个‘材质节点问题’。请拆开正确的生产路线。
evals.expected_output: Separate contexts and ownership: SOP creates/transfers geometry attributes; Copernicus/Texture Material Library authors procedural image/texture data when appropriate; Material Library/MaterialX assembles shader/material networks; Solaris/LOP composes USD and binds materials; Karma renders. Record context crossings and attribute/path semantics instead of treating all nodes as one graph.

evals.prompt: Fusion 里一个支架现在外形正确，但 30 个尺寸都是独立数字，Sketch 依赖多个后期倒角后的边。客户要求宽度、孔距和壁厚都能做系列变体。你会继续改 Timeline 里的数字，还是先重构？
evals.expected_output: Route through KN-THEORY-3D-MODELING-ESSENCE-001 and Fusion CAD evidence. Identify representation, design intent, primary user parameters and constraint graph before editing geometry. Replace fragile incidental face/edge references with stable origin/datum/construction references where practical, express symmetry/concentric/pitch/thickness relations instead of duplicated coordinates, then sweep key parameters and inspect recompute failures. Current appearance is not sufficient evidence of a robust parametric model.

evals.prompt: FreeCAD Part Design 的零件能正常显示，但上游长度一改，后面的 Pocket 和 Fillet 经常失效。有人建议把所有 feature 都删掉改成一个最终 STEP，再直接修形。按 Oleander 怎么判断？
evals.expected_output: Do not default to either preserving every fragile feature or collapsing immediately to a dumb final solid. Route to modeling essence and FreeCAD evidence; inspect Body feature order, sketch/datum attachment, incidental face/edge references, primary constraints and failure envelope. Rebuild unstable dependencies around stable datums/named intent when long-lived parametric editability is required; use direct/imported-solid repair only when history semantics are intentionally not required. Validate recompute, geometry and STEP/native reopen; a visible solid does not prove robust design intent or manufacturing approval.
